description: The first Su-15 built at Novosibirsk, works number 0015301, first flown 6 March 1966 by test pilot I.F. Sorokin; later used as a flying laboratory tanker on the Sakhalin programme. Preserved on the design bureau grounds. Wears bort number 01; recorded without a tail number because another airframe of this type in the database already carries it.
Works number 03301, bort 01, on the design bureau grounds.
Works number 2008, bort 28. Brought to the design bureau from the Moscow Aviation Institute.
Bort 30, on the design bureau grounds; no construction number recorded.
Bort 42, on the design bureau grounds; no construction number recorded.
Carrier fighter displayed on the design bureau grounds; no bort or construction number recorded.
Single-seat aerobatic aircraft, works number recorded as 003 with a query; also carries "03 black".
Displayed on the Sukhoi design bureau grounds as bort "42 white". A monument aircraft; original status not established.
